entities.name: Sidelink UE capability transfer
entities.description: Procedure for transferring sidelink UE capability information between network and UE.

entities.name: UE sidelink capabilities
entities.description: Information element containing UE's sidelink communication capabilities.

entities.name: RRC connection
entities.description: RRC connected state required for capability transfer procedures.

relations.description: The sidelink UE capability transfer procedure involves the exchange of UE sidelink capabilities information element.
The sidelink UE capability transfer procedure requires the UE to be in RRC connected state.
The sidelink UE capability transfer procedure is defined in clause 5.8.9.2 of TS 38.331.
